---
title: "`r params$symbol`: does the candidate transcript's 5'UTR match the one our cells express?"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
params:
  symbol: "BCL2L12"
  given_tx: "ENST00000441864"
---

**Why.** BCL2L12 is an eIF3d target (Exclusive category) in hypoxia 1hr in both MDA-MB-231
and MCF7-SIX1 (`01_eif3d_hypoxia_target_lookup.Rmd`). That TE result is gene-level. The
transcript proposed as the reporter source (`params$given_tx`) is not the most abundant
BCL2L12 isoform in either cell line, so the question is whether its 5'UTR is the 5'UTR the
TE measurement mostly reflects.

Two things are checked:

1. **Sequence.** Every BCL2L12 5'UTR in GENCODE v49, built from exon coordinates
   (`fiveUTRsByTranscript`) on hg38, and the given 5'UTR compared against each.
2. **Abundance.** Salmon TPM per BCL2L12 transcript in the samples the TE was measured on
   (hypoxia 1hr, siCTRL and si3d RNA-seq), in each cell line, as a share of the gene's TPM.
   This is the isoform mixture the gene-level result averages over.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (!exists("params") || !is.list(params)) {
  params <- list(symbol = "BCL2L12", given_tx = "ENST00000441864")
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(here)
  library(GenomicFeatures)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  library(Biostrings)
})
mcf_repo <- "/Users/katematlin/github/2024_eIF3e_hypoxia/2024_eIF3e_hypoxia"
out_dir  <- here("output", "finding_positive_controls")
```

## 1. Transcripts of the gene

```{r transcripts}
txdb <- loadDb(here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))
anno <- read_tsv(here("accessories", "human", "gene_anno_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv"),
                 col_names = c("gene_id", "symbol", "biotype", "species", "source"),
                 show_col_types = FALSE)
gene_v <- anno %>% filter(symbol == params$symbol) %>% distinct(gene_id) %>% pull(gene_id)
stopifnot(length(gene_v) == 1)

tx <- AnnotationDbi::select(txdb, keys = gene_v, keytype = "GENEID",
                            columns = c("TXNAME", "TXID")) %>%
  mutate(tx_clean = sub("\\..*", "", TXNAME))
stopifnot(params$given_tx %in% tx$tx_clean)

main_231 <- readRDS(here("output", "translational_control_overview", "feature_matrix_tco.rds")) %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean == sub("\\..*", "", gene_v)) %>% pull(transcript_id_clean)
main_mcf <- readRDS(here("output", "translational_control_overview", "feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds")) %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean == sub("\\..*", "", gene_v)) %>% pull(transcript_id_clean)
mane <- read_csv(here("accessories", "human", "mane_select_v49.csv"),
                 col_names = c("gene_id_clean", "transcript_id_clean", "symbol"),
                 show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean == sub("\\..*", "", gene_v)) %>% pull(transcript_id_clean)
stopifnot(length(mane) <= 1)
if (!length(main_231)) cat("Gene is not in the 231 feature matrix (no expressed-in-231 transcript recorded).\n")
if (!length(main_mcf)) cat("Gene is not in the MCF7-SIX1 feature matrix.\n")
cat("Given:", params$given_tx, "| expressed in 231:", main_231,
    "| expressed in MCF7-SIX1:", main_mcf, "| MANE Select:", mane, "\n")

utr_grl <- fiveUTRsByTranscript(txdb, use.names = TRUE)
cds_grl <- cdsBy(txdb, by = "tx", use.names = TRUE)
utr_seq <- extractTranscriptSeqs(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38,
                                 utr_grl[names(utr_grl) %in% tx$TXNAME])
names(utr_seq) <- sub("\\..*", "", names(utr_seq))

# first 3 nt of CDS, to confirm the UTR ends at an AUG
cds_start <- extractTranscriptSeqs(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38,
                                   cds_grl[names(cds_grl) %in% tx$TXNAME])
names(cds_start) <- sub("\\..*", "", names(cds_start))

tx_tbl <- tx %>%
  transmute(transcript = tx_clean, TXNAME) %>%
  mutate(utr5_len    = width(utr_seq)[match(transcript, names(utr_seq))],
         cds_len     = width(cds_start)[match(transcript, names(cds_start))],
         start_codon = as.character(subseq(cds_start, 1, 3))[match(transcript, names(cds_start))],
         role = str_remove(paste0(
           ifelse(transcript == params$given_tx, "; given", ""),
           ifelse(transcript %in% main_231, "; expressed in 231", ""),
           ifelse(transcript %in% main_mcf, "; expressed in MCF7-SIX1", ""),
           ifelse(transcript %in% mane, "; MANE Select", "")), "^; "))
knitr::kable(tx_tbl)
```

## 2. Sequence comparison

```{r compare}
given_seq <- utr_seq[[params$given_tx]]
stopifnot(length(given_seq) > 0)

cmp <- map_dfr(setdiff(names(utr_seq), params$given_tx), function(t) {
  s <- utr_seq[[t]]
  # the 3' end of the 5'UTR abuts the start codon; compare from that end
  a <- rev(strsplit(as.character(given_seq), "")[[1]])
  b <- rev(strsplit(as.character(s), "")[[1]])
  k <- min(length(a), length(b))
  shared_3p <- sum(cumprod(a[1:k] == b[1:k]))
  aln <- pairwiseAlignment(given_seq, s, type = "global")
  tibble(transcript = t, utr5_len = length(s),
         identical = as.character(s) == as.character(given_seq),
         given_is_3p_suffix = endsWith(as.character(s), as.character(given_seq)),
         other_is_3p_suffix = endsWith(as.character(given_seq), as.character(s)),
         shared_nt_from_AUG = shared_3p,
         pct_identity_global = round(pid(aln, type = "PID2"), 1))
})
if (nrow(cmp) == 0) {
  cat("No other transcript of this gene has an annotated 5'UTR to compare against.\n")
} else {
  cmp %>% arrange(desc(shared_nt_from_AUG)) %>% knitr::kable()
}
```

`shared_nt_from_AUG` counts how many nucleotides upstream of the start codon are identical
between the two 5'UTRs, reading 5' from the AUG. That is the part of the leader a scanning
ribosome sees last, and the part a reporter would share.

### Upstream AUGs

Every ATG in the 5'UTR, with its distance to the main start codon, whether it is in frame
with the main CDS, and where its reading frame stops: inside the 5'UTR (a uORF), or past
the main AUG (an overlapping ORF; in-frame ones would make an N-terminal extension).

```{r uaug}
uaug_table <- function(t) {
  u    <- as.character(utr_seq[[t]])
  full <- paste0(u, as.character(cds_start[[t]]))
  pos  <- as.integer(gregexpr("ATG", u, fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
  pos  <- pos[pos > 0]
  if (!length(pos)) return(tibble(transcript = t, uATG_pos = NA_integer_))
  map_dfr(pos, function(p) {
    codons <- substring(full, seq(p, nchar(full) - 2, 3), seq(p + 2, nchar(full), 3))
    stop_i <- which(codons %in% c("TAA", "TAG", "TGA"))[1]
    stop_end <- if (is.na(stop_i)) NA_integer_ else p + 3 * stop_i - 1
    tibble(transcript = t, uATG_pos = p, nt_upstream_of_main_AUG = nchar(u) - p + 1,
           in_frame_with_CDS = (nchar(u) - p + 1) %% 3 == 0,
           context_m3_p4 = paste0(substr(full, p - 3, p - 3), "..ATG", substr(full, p + 3, p + 3)),
           orf_ends = case_when(is.na(stop_end) ~ "no stop in sequence",
                                stop_end <= nchar(u) ~ "inside 5'UTR (uORF)",
                                (nchar(u) - p + 1) %% 3 == 0 ~ "N-terminal extension (in frame, no stop before main AUG)",
                                TRUE ~ "past main AUG (overlapping)"),
           orf_codons = ifelse(is.na(stop_i), NA, stop_i))
  })
}
uaug <- map_dfr(unique(c(params$given_tx, main_231, main_mcf, mane)), uaug_table)
knitr::kable(uaug)
uaug %>% group_by(transcript) %>% summarise(n_uATG = sum(!is.na(uATG_pos))) %>% knitr::kable()
```

### Exon structure: given, expressed and MANE Select

```{r exons}
show_exons <- function(t) {
  g <- utr_grl[[tx$TXNAME[tx$tx_clean == t]]]
  tibble(transcript = t, exon = seq_along(g), chr = as.character(seqnames(g)),
         start = start(g), end = end(g), strand = as.character(strand(g)), width = width(g))
}
map_dfr(unique(c(params$given_tx, main_231, main_mcf, mane)), show_exons) %>% knitr::kable()
```

### Sequences

```{r seqs}
for (t in unique(c(params$given_tx, main_231, main_mcf, mane))) {
  cat(">", t, " 5'UTR, ", width(utr_seq[t]), " nt\n", sep = "")
  cat(paste(strsplit(as.character(utr_seq[[t]]), "(?<=.{60})", perl = TRUE)[[1]],
            collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
}
```

## 3. Isoform abundance in the TE samples (hypoxia 1hr RNA-seq)

```{r abundance}
read_quant <- function(f) {
  read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(transcript = sub("\\..*", "", str_extract(Name, "^[^|]+")), TPM)
}

meta231 <- read_csv(here("accessories", "metadata_231_timecourse.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(type == "Input_Ribo_RNAseq", condition == "hypoxia", hours == 1,
         treatment %in% c("siCTRL", "si3d")) %>%
  transmute(id, treatment = ifelse(treatment == "siCTRL", "sictrl", treatment),
            file = here("2025_MDAcells_riboseq", "salmon", id, "quant.sf.gz"),
            cell = "MDA-MB-231")
metamcf <- read_csv(file.path(mcf_repo, "counts/calculate_te/metadata.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(library == "rna", condition == "hypoxia", treatment %in% c("sictrl", "si3d")) %>%
  transmute(id = sample_id, treatment,
            file = file.path(mcf_repo, "salmon", sample_id, "quant.sf.gz"),
            cell = "MCF7-SIX1")
meta <- bind_rows(meta231, metamcf)
stopifnot(nrow(meta) == 12, all(file.exists(meta$file)))

ab <- meta %>%
  mutate(q = map(file, read_quant)) %>%
  unnest(q) %>%
  filter(transcript %in% tx$tx_clean)

share <- ab %>%
  group_by(cell, treatment, transcript) %>%
  summarise(TPM = mean(TPM), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(share_pct = round(100 * TPM / sum(TPM), 1), TPM = round(TPM, 2)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(tx_tbl %>% dplyr::select(transcript, utr5_len, role), by = "transcript")

share %>%
  dplyr::select(cell, treatment, transcript, role, utr5_len, TPM, share_pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = c(TPM, share_pct)) %>%
  arrange(cell, desc(share_pct_sictrl)) %>%
  knitr::kable()

write_csv(share, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s_isoform_share_hypoxia_1hr.csv", params$symbol)))
```
